source_title: Phantom Blade Zero: How to Get Forest Outpost Courtyard Key - GameRant
source_excerpt:
After visiting the Thieves' Den in Crimson Forest , players will make their way through the caverns and arrive at a locked gate that will require the Forest Outpost Courtyard key in Phantom Blade Zero . It can be found nearby, but you'll need to defeat a few enemies before reaching it. Here's a complete guide on how to find the Forest Outpost Courtyard Key and progress to the next area.
How to Get the Forest Outpost Courtyard Key in Phantom Blade Zero
Right after meeting Yu'er at the Thieves' Camp , players will make their way through the caverns and arrive at the Forest Outpost Courtyard's locked door.
To get the Forest Outpost Courtyard Key in Phantom Blade Zero , you'll need to head directly opposite the door and defeat some enemies who're already fighting each other. Once you're done, head up the stairway beside you, and you'll enter an elevated area with some more enemies.
After dealing with the enemies, you'll need to go up the stairs to the house I've marked above.
There's also a purple chest in the house next to the stairs that you can open up to get a Blackstone Fragment .
Inside the house, you can pick up the Forest Outpost Courtyard key from a table next to the bonfire . Now, head back to the locked door, and you'll be able to progress to the next area of the Crimson Forest.
Make sure to visit the mountain lodge in the next area to progress the "Secrets of Baishan Sect" quest in Phantom Blade Zero .
